critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now ~4896 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (companies_router.py, notifications_router.py, hr_router.py).
The display_id backfill runs unconditionally on every startup; while it is idempotent, consider gating it behind an env flag for production to avoid unnecessary DB chatter on every restart.

Birthday notification id format `bday-{type}-{cid}-{md}` does not include the year — a person whose birthday was already greeted yesterday will get the same id again next year (good for idempotent dispatch). However, dispatch-emails idempotency check based purely on id will block re-sending in subsequent years. Consider including the year in the id.

_next_company_display_id() reads max via $regex+sort on every call — if companies grow large, an explicit counters collection would be more efficient and concurrency-safe (currently two simultaneous POSTs could allocate the same C-id).
Members.jsx already supports display_id in card view but not in the more commonly-used table view — visual inconsistency.
